core.headline: First-floor two-bedroom flat with lift and allocated parking
core.listing:
A first-floor purpose-built flat in Chatham with two bedrooms, a lift and one allocated parking space.

The accommodation comprises an open-plan kitchen and living room with a Juliet balcony, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Gas central heating is installed throughout.

Outside, there is one allocated parking space.

The property is offered at a guide price of £195,000. The tenure is leasehold with 99 years remaining and a service charge of £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026). Council Tax Band B. EPC rating C.

emailBlast.headline: First-floor flat with balcony and lift, Chatham ME4
emailBlast.body:
We are pleased to offer this two-bedroom first-floor flat at a guide price of £195,000. The property is leasehold with 99 years remaining and a service charge of £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026).

The accommodation comprises an open-plan kitchen/living room with Juliet balcony, two bedrooms and a bathroom. The building benefits from lift access, and there is one allocated parking space.

Council tax band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. The property is connected to mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and has gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Full material information is on the property listing.
emailBlast.personalMessage: A two-bedroom first-floor purpose-built flat in Chatham ME4 at a guide price of £195,000. The property offers an open-plan kitchen/living room with Juliet balcony, lift access to the first floor, and one allocated parking space. Leasehold with 99 years remaining. Council tax band B, EPC C. Please get in touch to arrange a viewing.
